purpose: Manual post-model corrections for exact surface+reading learner-difficulty rows where scalar difficulty, display form, and standalone SRS admission diverge.

score_fields.min_score: Raise the effective learner-difficulty score to at least this value.
score_fields.score_override: Replace the effective learner-difficulty score exactly. Prefer min_score unless a row is fully reviewed.

correction_types.display_only: Score is fine, but the learner-facing spelling should be different.
correction_types.score_override: The correct beginner/admission row exists, but the model under-ranked it; set the effective score directly.
correction_types.score_floor: The row is valid vocabulary, but the model placed it too early.
correction_types.restricted_admission: The row is valid data, but should not be ordinary standalone SRS vocabulary.
correction_types.exclude_standalone_srs: Keep the row for audit/search/data completeness, but do not serve it as standalone new vocabulary.

policy.display_form: Preferred learner-facing spelling when the lexical item is easy but the listed written form is not beginner-friendly.
policy.admission_override: Standalone SRS admission class. Topic stretching is derived from this class and correction_types, not hand-authored per row.
policy.topic_stretch_derivation: Topic preference may stretch normal_vocab rows. It should not override restricted_admission or exclude_standalone_srs rows.
